calibration_authority_status: provisional; governing methodology not immutably bound
reconciliation_requirement: Each candidate must be checked against the frozen methodology before it can support a methodology revision proposal.

observations_about_issue_supplied_instru.observation: The methodology requires immutable references but the execution instructions did not specify an acceptable fallback when authoritative artifacts are absent or not yet frozen.
The lifecycle relationship among Deviation Records, Failure Records, Failure Assessment, execution validity, transfer determination, and final conclusion requires explicit ordering guidance.
The instruction to use definitions exactly is difficult to replay unless the definitions are packaged with content hashes or repository paths.
Forced-fit indicators should remain assessment criteria or instrument-test inputs tied to actual concept mappings, not Structology concepts under investigation.
Source provenance should require replay-safe excerpts, normalized observation bases, hashes, or immutable snapshots rather than live URLs alone.
